algorithms.name: X25519
constraints: A consuming protocol MUST define public-key handling, transcript binding, and contributory-behavior requirements.
X25519 alone does not authenticate a peer.

algorithms.name: ECDH over NIST P-256
constraints: A consuming protocol MUST define point validation, key confirmation where required, and transcript binding.

algorithms.name: ECDH over NIST P-384
constraints: A consuming protocol MUST define point validation, key confirmation where required, and transcript binding.

algorithms.name: HPKE DHKEM(X25519, HKDF-SHA256)
constraints: MUST be used with HPKE semantics rather than treated as raw X25519 key agreement.

algorithms.name: HPKE DHKEM(P-256, HKDF-SHA256)
constraints: MUST be used with HPKE semantics and the P-256 encoding defined by RFC 9180.

algorithms.name: HPKE DHKEM(P-384, HKDF-SHA384)
constraints: MUST be used with HPKE semantics and the P-384 encoding defined by RFC 9180.

algorithms.name: ML-KEM-512

algorithms.name: ML-KEM-1024
constraints: A consuming profile MUST define protocol binding, key-combination rules when hybridized, and exact FIPS 203 behavior including applicable errata.

constraints: A consuming profile MUST define signature context, key identity, serialization, and domain separation requirements.

algorithms.name: ECDSA P-256 with SHA-256

algorithms.name: AES-128-GCM
constraints: Nonce uniqueness requirements MUST be enforced by the consuming protocol; tag truncation is prohibited unless a later profile explicitly analyzes and permits it.

algorithms.name: ChaCha20-Poly1305

algorithms.name: AES-256-GCM-SIV
constraints: MUST NOT be substituted for AES-GCM under the same algorithm identifier or wire format; consuming profiles MUST explicitly select it.

algorithms.name: MD5
algorithms.status_reason: Cryptographically broken collision resistance and unsuitable for E2EESA security claims.
constraints: MUST NOT be used to provide a cryptographic security property in a conformant E2EESA configuration.

algorithms.name: SHA-1
algorithms.status_reason: Collision resistance is insufficient for new E2EESA cryptographic constructions.
constraints: MUST NOT be used to provide a cryptographic security property in a conformant E2EESA configuration.
